setup.zh: 那天晚上，你给家里写了第一封信。窗外，下雪了。
setup.en: That night you write your first letter home. Outside, it is snowing.

recap.zh: 你给家里写了第一封信：「娘，漏勺也能打水。」窗外下雪了；木牌轻轻地烫了一下——那张饼，还欠着。
recap.en: You wrote your first letter home: "Ma, a skimmer can carry water too." Outside it snowed; the token warmed, just a little — the flatbread is still owed.

en: "Ma, a skimmer can carry water too."

story.zh:
小满趴在铺上，给家里写了第一封信。写账他会，一笔一笔，横平竖直；写信却是另一回事。他头一句写的是「娘，我当上仙人了」，写完了一看，不对，还差得远，擦了；第二句写的是「娘，我打赢了马小宝」，写完了想了想，这句话要是传到村里，马三怕是要上门，又擦了；第三句写的是「娘，我吃得饱」，这是真话，可他想起他娘看信的样子——他娘看什么都要看两遍，看完了还要想——便又擦了，怕她想多。他写了擦，擦了写，墨磨了三回，纸换了两张，末了只写成了这么几行：

**娘：**

**我进仙门了。一年五两，观里说腊月就送到家。**

**屋顶修一修。盆可以收起来了。十七个都收。**

**给我爹买一副护膝，狗皮的。**

**给吴婆婆，再送一条鹿腿。这回是买的。**

**给阿禾家，赔两颗白菜。一颗是那年砸的，一颗是过年吃的。**

**我拜了师父。师父是扫台阶的。他扫了五十年。他问起你。**

**我在这里很好。有人欺负我，我记着账。有几笔，已经还上了。**

**——小满**

他把信折好，想了想，又打开来，在最底下添了一行：

**娘，漏勺也能打水。**

写完了，他把笔放下，望着那一行字发了一会儿呆。他想起他娘蹲在灶台边上，一片一片捡那只碗的碎片。他想起入门那天，测灵石亮起五种颜色，满殿哄笑。他想起今天崖顶上瞿老说的那一句：四千年前，禹王要的，就是这五种颜色的土。他很想把这句话也写进信里，写了两个字，又拿笔涂掉了。这句话，他想等回了家，当面说给他娘听。

信封好了，压在枕头底下。明天一早交给周衡，跟沈家那一包五两银子一车送下山，周衡说，腊月二十前能到石坳村。邮资，记账。
story.en:
Xiaoman lay on his bunk and wrote his first letter home. Accounts he could write, stroke by stroke, straight and level; a letter was another matter. His first line was "Ma, I've become an immortal" — he looked at it: wrong, still a long way off; rubbed it out. His second was "Ma, I beat Ma Xiaobao" — he thought: if this got back to the village Ma San might come to the door; rubbed it out. His third was "Ma, I get enough to eat" — true, but he thought of how his mother read things — twice over, and then she'd think about it — and rubbed it out too, afraid she'd think too much. He wrote and rubbed out, rubbed out and wrote, ground ink three times, changed paper twice, and in the end had only these few lines:

**Ma:**

**I'm in the sect. Five taels a year; the temple says it'll reach home by the twelfth month.**

**Fix the roof. You can put the basins away. All seventeen.**

**Buy Pa a pair of knee pads. Dog skin.**

**Take Granny Wu another deer leg. Bought, this time.**

**Pay Ah He's family two cabbages. One for the one smashed that year, one for eating at New Year.**

**I've found a master. My master sweeps steps. Fifty years he's swept. He asked about you.**

**I'm well here. When people bully me I keep the accounts. Some of them I've paid back already.**

**— Xiaoman**

He folded the letter, thought, opened it again, and added one line at the very bottom:

**Ma, a skimmer can carry water too.**

When he'd written it he put down the brush and stared at the line a while. He thought of his mother crouching by the stove, picking up the pieces of that bowl one by one. He thought of the day he entered the sect, the testing stone lighting five colours, the whole hall laughing. He thought of what Elder Qu had said on the cliff today: four thousand years ago, what King Yu wanted was exactly these five colours of earth. He wanted very much to put that in the letter too; wrote two characters, and inked them out. That, he wanted to say to his mother face to face, when he got home.

He sealed the letter and put it under his pillow. Tomorrow morning he'd give it to Zhou Heng to go down the mountain in one cart with the Shen family's five taels; Zhou Heng said it would reach Stone Hollow before the twentieth of the twelfth month. Postage: on the books.

exits.means: rests, ends the day, or asks what comes next

story.zh:
大通铺上鼾声一片。隔着三个铺位，孙二狗在梦里嘟囔了一句什么，翻了个身，手还按在腰里那个蓝布包上。

小满躺下来，握着胸口的木牌。木牌是暖的，那条银色的尾巴亮着，一明，一暗，慢得像一个人在很深很深的地方睡觉。

他小声道：「银月。」

木牌没有回答。

他又道：「今天拜师了。师父让我填一笔。」

木牌没有回答。

他又道：「你欠我的那张饼……还欠着吧？」

木牌轻轻地，烫了一下。

像是在说：**还欠着。**

窗外的雪，下了一夜。
story.en:
Snores all along the big bunk. Three places over, Sun Ergou mumbled something in his sleep and turned over, his hand still on the blue cloth bag at his waist.

Xiaoman lay down and held the token on his chest. The token was warm; the silver tail was lit — bright, dark — slow, like someone sleeping very, very deep.

He whispered, "Yinyue."

The token didn't answer.

"I found a master today," he said. "He wants me to fill in a stroke."

The token didn't answer.

"That flatbread you owe me… still owed, right?"

The token went hot, lightly, once.

As if to say: **Still owed.**

Outside the window, the snow fell all night.
